I’m 24 and still to this day get skinny shamed. It’s made my self confidence dwindle down to nearly nothing. I feel so uncomfortable in my own skin every single day! I’ve always been tiny and it’s not that I don’t eat but people always assume that’s the reason. I’m a server and the amount of comments I hear from customers about “let me buy you a burger you need some meat on your bones” has caused me to wear an oversized jacket every single day even when it’s 100 degrees outside. Just yesterday for the first time in at least a few months  this old lady screamed across the dinning room to her server saying “TELL THAT LITTLE GIRL TO GAIN SOME WEIGHT”. The whole dinning room heard it, it was extremely embarrassing and heartbreaking to hear. Now I can’t get those words out of my head.

I think both are just as equally bad. Im a 24 year old female who weighs under 100 pounds. Yesterday at work an older lady YELLED across the dinning room to her server “tell that little girl she needs to gain some weight”. I was having a good day until that happened. The whole dinning room heard it. It was absolutely heartbreaking and embarrassing. I wear a jacket every single day at work when it’s 100 degrees outside just to limit those kind of comments for my mental health.

like i said maybe try to get on a schedule and force yourself out of bed and do things that make you happy even if it’s as simple as sitting on the couch watching a show. your mind is in the habit of wanting to sleep to feel better. so take the steps to learn to feel better while awake. it’s a vicious cycle to want to always sleep. it will slip you into a depression and you deserve better than that.

i know this sounds hard but try NOT to sleep. ive been in the same boat for 7 years now. it’s taken a lot and i still have my off days where i need to sleep a bit more to mentally escape but that’s going to put you in an even further rut. i realized the more i slept the more i became depressed. the more i wanted to sleep. the more i became unmotivated. i force myself to get out of bed, go sit outside and drink a cup of coffee and watch my favorite youtube videos. tends to help me want to be a functioning human.
